author: Zoro987
quote: This game does not deserve a 99/100. Those reviews were obviously bought. Sick of hearing about this boring ass game. The story is so cliche.

author: Zoro987
quote: Love all the 0 scores for the dumbest reason. Game is amazing! I have had an absolute blast going through the story. I can’t believe how petty people are acting over absolutely no issue.

author: Zoro987
quote: Not my favorite expansion but far from being bad. I’m finding myself having so much fun with this expansion. The story definitely gets better the longer you go. I can see why that may bother some people. The new jobs are an absolute blast to play. The music has been fantastic. The new graphic update is better than I thought it would be.

author: Zoro987
quote: Final Fantasy 16 is not a perfect game. It by far the best Final Fantasy to come out in quite some time. I’m absolutely shocked this game is being hated on. I’m assuming it’s because it’s not turn based? Either way this game should be looked at for what it’s done for the series. Yoshi P and creative business unit 3 thank you for all you do for us Final Fantasy fans. You have reminded me why I love this series so much.
